data.gender_notes: Balaraju is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balaraju is a name of Sanskrit origin. The name is derived from the words 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Raju' meaning king or ruler. This name signifies a powerful and mighty ruler or leader. The name Balaraju carries the meaning “Powerful Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balaraju usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
